    <h2><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao/p/22559609" title="发布于 2026-08-19 07:08">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">切换 Embedding 模型时，千万别忽略历史向量维度</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-08-19 07:09">2026-08-19 07:08</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(22559609);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F22559609&amp;targetId=22559609&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>笔者最近在测试知识库系统时，因原 Embedding 模型不可用而切换了新模型。看似只是更换模型，却因为历史向量仍在数据库中，导致文档重新解析后依然报错。</p>
<h2 id="01--问题关键向量维度不一致">01 | 问题关键：向量维度不一致</h2>
<p>不同 Embedding 模型输出的向量维度可能不同。例如，笔者测试的旧模型输出过 2560 维，新模型为 1536 维；而最终排查发现，历史记忆表中还存有 2048 维向量。</p>
<p>当新旧向量混在同一套问答链路中，就可能触发维度不匹配错误。</p>
<h2 id="02--重新解析文档为何无效">02 | 重新解析文档为何无效</h2>
<p>笔者多次重新解析文档仍报错。原因是重新解析仅影响文本向量表 <code>kbot_biz_txt_embedding</code>，但旧的记忆向量还保存在 <code>kbot_md_memory_entry</code> 中。</p>
<p>可先检查两张表的向量维度：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(memory_vector) AS dimensions,
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_FORMAT(memory_vector) AS element_format,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM kbot_md_memory_entry
WHERE memory_vector IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(memory_vector),
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_FORMAT(memory_vector)
ORDER BY dimensions, element_format;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(embedding) AS dimensions,
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_FORMAT(embedding) AS element_format,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM kbot_biz_txt_embedding
WHERE kb_id = 41
GROUP BY
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(embedding),
 VECTOR_DIMENSION_FORMAT(embedding)
ORDER BY dimensions, element_format;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="03--清理旧记忆前务必确认">03 | 清理旧记忆前务必确认</h2>
<p>还可以直接查看两张表：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">select * from kbot_biz_txt_embedding;
select * from kbot_md_memory_entry;
</code></pre>
<p>确认 <code>kbot_md_memory_entry</code> 存在过时维度的历史向量后，才谨慎清理：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">truncate table kbot_md_memory_entry;
</code></pre>
<p>笔者清空该表中的旧信息后，问答恢复正常，不再报错。</p>
<p>切换 Embedding 模型时，除了重新解析文件，更要检查历史记忆向量是否仍使用旧维度。只有相关向量维度统一，知识库问答才能稳定运行。</p>
<p>关注我，和AI一起成长~</p>
